hero.subtitle: Tau fakalataha he tau faila peer-to-peer fou
hero.description: Ne taute aki e tekinolosia decentralized fou. Nakai fai server taha. Nakai fai matakavi taha ka mahala.

about.title: Hagaaki ke
about.intro: {project} ko e platform fou ke fakalataha aki e tau faila peer-to-peer, ne taute aki e tekinolosia decentralized fou. Kua fakalauia e interface mukamuka ke fakaaoga mo e architecture decentralized katoa, ne fakamoli e fakalataha aki e tau faila kua mauoa mo e tonuhia mo e nakai aoga ke fai pule taha. Ko e galue nei ko e open source, ne tukutuku ai he {license}.

decentralized.title: Matahau decentralized katoa
decentralized.description: Nakai fai server taha, nakai fai matakavi taha ka mahala. Kua moua mo e pakipaki hifo e tau tagata fakaaoga e tau koloa hagaohi mai he tau tagata, nakai falanaki ke he index taha, tracker, po ke database.

accessControl.title: Pulega fakaikiiki
accessControl.description: Kua maeke he tau tagata oti ke taute e matahau ha lautolu mo e tau fakatufono ha lautolu noa. Ki loto he tau matahau oti, ko e tau fua he tau tagata fakaaoga ke fakamaama: tagata-eke, administrator, fakapuloa, moderator, mo e mui. Kua ha ha ia koe e pulega fakaikiiki hagaaki ke he hai e maeke ke fakapuloa, moderate, mo e pakipaki hifo e tau koloa.

ui.title: Interface mitaki ke fakaaoga
ui.description: Ko e interface meā mo e tali vave he media center, ne taute ke he desktop, televise, mo e mobile platforms. Kua mukamuka ke fano aki e keyboard, ratoa, gamepad, po ke remote. Ko e tau tagata fakaaoga lahi kua maeke ke fakaaoga e software ko e headless data server ke he interface line command.

dataFormat.title: Matakupu ka maeke he tagata ke totou
dataFormat.description: Ko e matakupu LISH ne taute aki e JSON, ne taute mukamuka e taute, totou, mo e maama. Fakalataha aki e tau koloa hau mo e metadata kotoa mo e maama, ne maeke he tau tagata oti ke kitia mukamuka.

security.title: Mauoa mo e haohao
security.description: Ko e tau fakafetuiaga peer-to-peer oti kua encrypted, ne fakamoli e tau koloa hau ke tumau ke he mauoa he transit. Kua maeke he tau tagata fakaaoga ke pa fakamua ke he VPN ke he anonymity uho atu. {project} kua tagahau e mauoa hau mai he taute ai.

crossPlatform.title: Tau platform oti
crossPlatform.description: Ko e software kua moua ke he Windows, Linux, mo e macOS. Fakaaoga ke he platform ne manako e koe.

download.title: Pakipaki hifo
download.description: Moua e {project} ke he platform haau. Ko e tau pakipaki hifo oti kua nakai fai totoogi mo e open source.
